tables.name: Hired Help Size
tables.description: Rolled for each hired help the town has.

results.name: Individual Person
results.description: The hired help is a single person hiring out their services.

results.name: Team
results.description: The hired help is a team of individuals who work together.

results.name: Guild
results.description: An organized guild is hiring out their services. When hired, a portion of the guild’s members handle the job, not the entire guild (unless the job is very large).
